blocks.tamil_translation: am seeing it with my eyes. It is as if I see the people of Jannah meeting one another. It is as if I hear the people of Jahannam crying out. (Thus the thought of the Hereafter is in my mind at all times),” he replied. On hearing his reply the Prophet ﷺ said, “(You are) a Mu'min whose heart has been illuminated with the light (of Iman).” Hazrat Salih ibn Mismar and Hazrat Ja'far ibn Burqan (RH) both narrate this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مَاعِزٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ: أَيُّ اْلاَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: إِيمَانٌ بِاللهِ وَحْدَهُ ثُمَّ الْجِهَادُ ثُمَّ حَجَّةٌ بَرَّةٌ تَفْضُلُ سَائِرَ الْعَمَلِ كَمَا بَيْنَ مَطْلَعِ الشَّمْسِ إِلي مَغْرِبِهَا.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ma'iz (RA) narrates that when the Prophet ﷺ was asked, “Which is the best of deeds?” the Prophet ﷺ said, “Iman in Allah, the One, then Jihad, then an accepted Hajj; these deeds are the best above all other deeds. The difference between these and the other deeds is like the difference between the east and the west.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: ذَكَرَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ الِلّهِ ﷺ يَوْماً عِنْدَهُ الدُّنْيَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَلَا تَسْمَعُونَ! أَلَا تَسْمَعُونَ!! إِنَّ الْبَذَاذَةَ مِنَ اْلإِيمَانِ إِنَّ الْبَذَاذَةَ مِنَ اْلإِيمَانِ يَعْنِي: اَلتَّقَحُّلَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداود، باب النهي عن كثير من الارفاه رقم:٤١٦١
blocks.tamil_translation: “One day in the gathering of the Prophet ﷺ the Sahabah were talking about the world. “Listen carefully! Listen carefully! Indeed simplicity is a part of Iman. Indeed simplicity is a part of Iman,” the Prophet ﷺ
